title: Build the Thermite parser with stable semantic addressing and per-item recovery

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Lexer + recursive-descent parser to AST. Two hard requirements from the design: (a) PER-ITEM error recovery — a syntax error in one item must not cascade into the next (design 4.3); parse items independently. (b) STABLE SEMANTIC ADDRESSING — deterministic numbering loop#1, inv#2, etc. (design 4.3) that survives unrelated edits, so forge edit-by-address and per-item proof cache keys work. Mandatory-contract enforcement: absent req/ens/fx is a parse error, not a default (design 4.1).

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
SHIPPED via the full ACToR loop. thermite-syntax implemented: lexer + AST + recovering parser + semantic addressing, verified against the hand-authored, critic-verified conformance/parse + conformance/address oracle. Commits: 32533e4 (build) -> 5bb910e (#28/#30) -> 2a8e3e3 (#29) -> f0ceb12 (#31) -> 90cef82 (#32) -> 358ec3c (#33). Plus oracle fixtures 53aa402, pinned tests a419e00.

The loop ran builder -> critic x5. The critic pinned and the fixers cleared SIX real divergences (all backed by failing tests, oracle never tampered per R-CHAR-3): #28 unit-return type rejected; #29 deep-expr stack overflow; #30 if/else-in-tail dropped to statement; #31 unbounded recursion in type/pattern/if; #32 unbounded recursion in loop bodies; #33 (regression from #30) value-less trailing if/else wrongly promoted to tail expr. The no-panic contract (parser.md AC-4) now holds across all probed recursion vectors via a single shared guard_recursion/MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH=64.

Final state: cargo test -p thermite-syntax = 20 passed, 0 ignored (9 conformance + 11 divergence/regression); workspace build + clippy -D warnings + fmt all green. Design docs .design/syntax/{surface-grammar,lexer,ast,parser,semantic-addressing}.md (REQ-status SHIPPED). Not pushed (human pushes).
